verdict.rationale: Turso docs explicitly describe issuing scoped tokens restricted by database, permission level, and expiration, plus fine-grained table/action-level permissions and JWKS-based JWT issuance, and the API reference notes each agent/user can get its own token-scoped database. This directly matches the story of issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of token scoping behavior and no explicit example tying scoped tokens specifically to an AI agent workflow beyond the MCP integration.
